question.prompt: The data 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 are already ordered, and \(n=5\). Find the 20th percentile. If \(i=n\times 20\%\) is an integer, take the mean of the values at positions \(i\) and \(i+1\).

solutions.explanation: \(i=1\). Take the 1st and 2nd values, which are 2 and 4. Their mean is 3.
solutions.title: Apply the integer-index percentile rule
